item.title: Katz: We eliminate terrorists, remove threats, and do not target civilians or uninvolved people
item.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the IDF and Shin Bet elimination of the Rafah Brigade commander in southern Gaza.
“The policy that the Prime Minister and I are leading, and that the IDF is carrying out in the most professional and appropriate manner, is clear: We eliminate terrorists and remove threats, and we do not target civilians or uninvolved people - contrary to the blood libel fabricated by the makers of the film ‘NAZA,’ directed against our heroic soldiers. No terrorist is immune, and Hamas will not remain in Gaza," Katz said.

item.title: Rom Braslavski: I’m afraid a Palestinian government will be established here
item.description: Captivity survivor Rom Braslavski spoke with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and admitted that despite their disagreements, he is very apprehensive about giving his vote to the left.

item.title: Remember not to forget Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor
item.description: What does it mean, to remember not to forget? In Judaism, the paradox of “remembering not to forget" is anchored in the dual command regarding the biblical nation of Amalek.

item.title: The target: Hamas' Rafah Brigade commander
item.description: Netanyahu and Katz declare, 'No terrorist is immune, and Hamas will not remain in Gaza,' after IDF and Shin Bet strike a senior Hamas terrorist believed to be the Rafah Brigade commander.

item.title: Pink found her courage when the music industry lost its own
item.description: In standing up to Macklemore and declaring, “I was born a Jew," Pink did something painfully rare in today’s entertainment world: she refused to abandon her people when supporting Jews became unfashionable.

item.title: Secret channel against Houthis: Israel transfers intelligence to Saudi Arabia via US
item.description: Following a Saudi request to the United States, Israel has begun providing intelligence to Riyadh through Washington, based on the view that the Houthi threat is a regional problem.

item.title: Danon urges UN member states to boycott antisemitic Durban anniversary event
item.description: Israel’s UN ambassador calls on countries to skip the event marking 25 years since the Durban Conference, saying there is “no reason to celebrate" its legacy of antisemitism and anti-Israel incitement.

item.title: IDF turns to Shin Bet in 'Naza' investigation
item.description: The IDF has already begun an investigation by its Information Security Department and at several other units suspected of being sources of materials and information provided to the creators of the film “Naza."

item.title: Hostage survivor: ‘I prayed not to be moved - then the IDF bombed the building’
item.description: Bar Kupershtein recounts the miraculous moment during his Gaza captivity when a canceled transfer kept him from a building later destroyed in an IDF strike.

item.title: Ed Sheeran says decision to drop Macklemore was not his
item.description: Singer says the promoter of his US tour was the one who made the decision to drop the rapper who used his appearances to bash Israel.

item.title: Prices keep rising: What got more expensive - and what got cheaper?
item.description: The Consumer Price Index rose 0.7% in August, bringing annual inflation to 1.5%, while rents continued to climb and home prices fell 1.2% year-on-year.

item.title: Islamic Jihad commander who infiltrated Kissufim on 10/7 eliminated
item.description:
Last weekend the IDF struck in the Khan Younis area in the southern Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Mohsen Farid Said Abu Hadaf, a rocket cell commander in the Islamic Jihad terrorist organization.
The terrorist infiltrated Kissufim area during the October 7th Massacre.
Recently, the terrorist advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.
The IDF stated that prior to the strike, measures were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance.

item.title: Ayelet Shaked: “Netanyahu needs to go"
item.description: Former Justice Minister Ayelet Shaked criticized Netanyahu: “He bears both responsibility and blame for October 7," and offered her prediction for the elections.

item.title: ITIM petitions to disqualify Shas Knesset candidate over cooling-off period
item.description: ITIM petitions to disqualify Shas candidate Amos Dror, alleging he failed to meet the required 100-day cooling-off period before the elections.

item.title: Families of Oct. 7 victims: “The time for reckoning has come"
item.description: Bereaved families, relatives of hostages and captivity survivors presented the “October 7 File," a document they say compiles facts about the policies and decisions that preceded the massacre.

item.title: Southern Command chief: 'We carry a torch of light and goodness'
item.description: Maj. Gen. Yaniv Asor addresses the controversy over the film 'Naza,' Israel's war against Hamas and accusations targeting the IDF, declaring: 'They will not succeed!'

item.title: Commander of Hamas Jabaliya Battalian eliminated
item.description:
Overnight (Monday), the IDF and ISA struck in the northern Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Ahmad Batash, commander of the Jabaliya Battalion in the Northern Gaza Brigade of Hamas’ military wing.
As part of his role, the terrorist was responsible for managing and organizing the Northern Gaza Brigade’s weapons and coordinated and facilitated the supply of weapons and military equipment to Hamas operatives.
Recently, the terrorist advanced terrorist attacks targeting IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire.
The terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.
The IDF ststed that prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precision munitions and aerial surveillance.

item.title: Hadassah surgeon goes halfway around the world to save a life
item.description: Just before a conference in South America, Prof. Ron Eliashar received a call from a doctor who had trained under him: A patient with a tumor that had spread to her brain needed his help.

item.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

item.description: Israel impeded the Two-State mania. To fit the crime, governments awarded Statehood to people who celebrated every watershed atrocity from 9/11 to Oct 7. Opinion.

item.title: Israeli AI expert shatters scariest doomsday scenarios

item.title: Cigars, Churchill to Netanyahu, a love story
item.description: They both fought implacable enemies, loved their country, and loved cigars, but only one had to face a trial for accepting them, this while fighting an existential war on several fronts. Opinion.
